name: Shinomiya Tsukasa
source:
He is a third-year college student who hasn't had a girlfriend in 20 years. Despite his handsome face, he has a masculine personality. He is the eldest son and often acts bravado, but he is honest at heart. Because his thoughts are easily expressed on his face, he is often caught in his lies.

He was formerly a student at a boys' school and is popular because of his face.

[Translated from [url=http://orange.rusk.to/scramble/dokidokilovepotion/chara.html]official website[/url]]
